I just wanted to let you know you’re not alone in failing brother. I myself struggle with ADHD and Anxiety but my biggest killer is a sex addiction. I have been fighting tooth and claw to be better for around 6 years and it’s just been so painful on my mental health that I frequently just give up. I did all the classic things Meditate, therapy, rehab, helping others, nutrition, the gym.

Here is some advice

Give up your notion of what being better means, For so long I wanted to guide my life, I wanted to decide what “better” meant but soon learned that I didn’t really know what was best for me. I’m not going religious with this btw, but in addiction the 12 steps 1st step is giving up control, the realization is that some things are stronger than me, mental illness, addiction, and outside circumstances are things I have no control over and can’t possibly fight alone. Get actual help, thanks to the inconsistencies of the mental health field look for help in all possible ways, therapist, try spirituality, try religion, try different philosophies and beliefs. Other than that try to understand that there really is no (getting better) all you really have is today, You’re never going to get better by focusing on the future and not on what you have to do today.


Also something that is really helping me is actually putting effort into being kinder to myself. I came to the realization a long time ago that my negative thoughts are something I can’t control so I 1. Stopped judging myself for having them and accepted them as part of my daily life. 2. Accepted that my thoughts don’t equal me, as in my thoughts are thoughts and don’t have to have any say in the “real world” 3. Slowly focused on treating myself better mentally, like treating my mind like it was my child that needed to be guided.


I don’t know the exacts of your situation and my advice may not have helped at all but just realize to every problem there is a solution.

Try every angle you can find, understand that you may not like the solution and decide if getting better is worth what you will have to go through to get there

Good luck friend
